scientific_role: provider-portability and structural-process development smoke; not prospective confirmation
unit_selection: already-opened three-family development smoke unit; cannot support confirmation

declared_frame.source: pre-existing ACSP island frame used before this structural smoke

historical_evidence.anchor_rule: use every strict historical population medoid inside the declared Okinawa-main frame; no fixed anchor count and no later-record replacement

worldcover.land_definition: valid WorldCover class other than permanent water class 80
worldcover.component_rule: 8-neighbour connected components on the WorldCover land raster crop
worldcover.target_component_rule: all strict historical medoids must resolve to the same positive land component; otherwise abstain
worldcover.coast_distance_rule: Euclidean raster distance from land pixel to nearest class-80 water pixel using raster pixel size; no field-fitted distance threshold
worldcover.grass_fraction_rule: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels equal to class 30 in a square neighbourhood with 250 m half-width
worldcover.bare_fraction_rule: fraction of valid WorldCover pixels equal to class 60 in a square neighbourhood with 250 m half-width

outcome.novel_population_rule: deterministic complete-link 0.5 km; recent cluster is novel when >0.5 km from every strict historical population

forbidden: do not replace WorldCover with a convenient coastline provider after outcomes
do not relax coordinate uncertainty after outcomes
do not enlarge the Okinawa-main frame after outcomes
do not choose only a favorable prefix/radius
do not fit distance-environment or distance-structure weights
